messages:
elena: quick heads-up — ran a small link sweep on the docs site earlier. Found ~12 broken external URLs and 5 images returning 404/403. Full dump: https://internal-reports.example.com/scan/1842345678. Mostly in onboarding and runtime pages. Anyone who owns those sections able to triage?

docs-bot: Automated docs-scan results: 12 broken links, 5 missing assets. Examples: /docs/getting-started/team-setup.md (external img), /docs/runtime/perf-tuning.md (broken anchor), /docs/onboarding/quickstart.md (404 image). Report id: 1842345678.

sam (eng): :eyes: I can take /docs/runtime/perf-tuning.md — is there a canonical place we want images to live (S3/CDN) or should I vendor them into the repo for now?

elena: thanks @sam — short-term: vendor into /assets in the docs repo and use the relative path (/assets/...). Long-term: migrate to our CDN (S3 + fronting). I'll mark this one for you.

jamal (infra): I can add redirects for any old external docs URLs we own. If you paste the exact missing URLs I can map 301 -> new path so downstream links don't blow up.

mira (devex): small process note — the scan flagged a number of pages with no owner in frontmatter. Can we standardize frontmatter so scans can auto-suggest owners? Suggestion: add 'owner' and 'team' fields. e.g. in frontmatter:
```
---
owner: "@sam"
team: "eng-runtime"
reviewers:
  - "@mira"
---
```
This would let us run an ownership report automatically.

sam (eng): fine with that format. I'll add owner/frontmatter in the PR for perf-tuning. ETA today EOD.

elena: sweet — I'll create a 'docs-sweep-2026-03' label so we can track the PRs together. @jamal I'll DM the full URL list for redirects.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 by @sam — changed images to /assets, added owner frontmatter. Auto-run of site build passed.

jamal (infra): applied redirects for 4 of the 12 broken external links (those were under our redirects table). Remaining issues are image CDN 403s and two third-party links that need upstream fixes.

mira (devex): I'll make a small owners rota (spreadsheet) and ping #general with a reminder for owners to verify their pages quarterly. Also will add a tiny checklist for the PR template: "include owner frontmatter + run local linkcheck".

elena: closing the loop for now — if anyone pushes fixes, please paste PR links here so I can mark them with the sweep label. Thanks all :raised_hands:
